title: Even the villain's side rated him

verse.sanskrit:
रामो विग्रहवान् धर्मः साधुः सत्यपराक्रमः ।
राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानामिव वासवः ॥
verse.iast:
rāmo vigrahavān dharmaḥ sādhuḥ satyaparākramaḥ |
rājā sarvasya lokasya devānām iva vāsavaḥ ||
verse.translation: Rama is dharma in bodily form, good, truly valiant, the king of the whole world as Indra is of the gods.

beats.title: even the bad guys rated him 10/10
beats.vo: Fans hyping you up? Easy. Rivals hyping you up? That's the real review.

beats.title: PLOT TWIST
beats.vo: Ravana wants to carry off Sita, and he asks the demon Maricha to help. Maricha, a total villain himself, says: bro, no.
Because he's been there. Years ago he stormed a sage's ritual, saw young Rama, and thought: just a kid. One arrow later, he was flying a hundred yojanas into the ocean.
And Rama didn't even want to kill him. So Maricha tells Ravana: Rama is not harsh. He is not ignorant. He is not ruled by his impulses.
Rama is dharma in human form. Good, truly brave, the king of the whole world.
Anyone can get likes from their fans. Real ones get respect from the other side.
So play it so fair that even the people who lose to you can't talk trash about you.

beats.title: Day 9 of learning from Rama
beats.vo: Day nine of learning from Rama. Send this to the rival who secretly respects you.

Any trending 'even my haters agree' audio
caption:
Even the villain's side rated him 10/10 🦌

When Ravana asked Maricha to help him carry off Sita, Maricha refused. He remembered young Rama sending him flying a hundred yojanas into the ocean with one arrow, and sparing his life. His verdict on Rama:

“रामो विग्रहवान् धर्मः साधुः सत्यपराक्रमः । राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानामिव वासवः ॥”
Valmiki Ramayana, Aranya Kanda 37.13 (the flashback is in 38.15–20)

Be someone even your rivals respect. Day 9 of learning from Rama.
